hypothesis: Adding 4h variance allows a compact depth-2 median XGBoost to improve magnitude predictions beyond liquidation inputs alone and the refitted additive pair.
settings_status: Fixed starting choices, not previously established optimal settings. No hyperparameter grid or early stopping. Native NaN handling for XGBoost; no future imputation.
pair_control: Unregularized median regression on fold-standardized, fold-median-imputed values and missing flags; refitted architecture, not the frozen MP0004 coefficients.
selection: Lowest pooled per-row out-of-fold MAE among the two XGBoost candidates; exact ties favor pair-only. Report failure if it does not beat both controls. Monthly and block diagnostics do not trigger further unregistered search.
final_refits: Reserved for selected XGBoost, refitted pair and training median after fresh-test timestamp metadata confirms allowed fitting cutoff. Not automatically executed.
fresh_test_policy: Do not read fresh test targets until procedure and evaluation rules frozen.
